fields.description: Header block identifier/version word of the 0x24-byte SRAM header at 0x0000.
fields.evidence: First word of the 0x24-byte block written by FUN_080027e4 via FUN_080027a4(0x0E000000, 0x02000000, 0x24) and re-written/verified by FUN_08002860 / FUN_08002918 with param_1 bit 0; baseline value 8.
fields.name: save_id

fields.description: Second header word (RNG/seed field) of the 0x24-byte SRAM header.
fields.evidence: Bytes 0x04-0x07 of the 0x24-byte header block written by FUN_080027e4 via FUN_080027a4(0x0E000000, 0x02000000, 0x24); baseline value 0x00F841C1.
fields.name: save_seed

fields.description: First option byte in the header block (byte 0x18); mutated through the option-save path.
fields.evidence: Byte 0x18 of the 0x24-byte header persisted by FUN_08002860 (bit 0) and verified by FUN_08002918 (bit 1,0); option bytes are staged by FUN_0800ed4c (DAT_0800edb0+0x10 masked with 0xF, DAT_0800edb0+0x58 array) and unpacked by FUN_08002bc8; baseline value 1.
fields.name: opt_value_a

fields.description: Second option byte in the header block (byte 0x19); mutated through the option-save path.
fields.evidence: Byte 0x19 of the 0x24-byte header persisted by FUN_08002860 (bit 0) and verified by FUN_08002918 (bit 1,0); option bytes are staged by FUN_0800ed4c and unpacked by FUN_08002bc8; baseline value 0x0D.
fields.name: opt_value_b

fields.description: Stored 32-bit word at the end of the 0x24-byte header (no Schema-v2 checksum algorithm verified against baseline, so kept as a plain field).
fields.evidence: Bytes 0x20-0x23 of the 0x24-byte header block written by FUN_080027e4 via FUN_080027a4(0x0E000000, 0x02000000, 0x24); baseline value 0x90867342; sum8/sum16/sum32/crc32 hypotheses over bytes 0x00-0x1F do not match, so no checksums[] entry is emitted.
fields.name: header_check

fields.description: Mode selector byte of leaderboard record 0 in the 400-byte block at 0x0040.
fields.evidence: Byte 0 of the 16-byte record at save offset 0x40 inside the 400-byte block written by FUN_08002860 (param_1 bit 1, size 400) and verified by FUN_08002918 (bit 1); all 25 records use 16-byte stride; baseline value 2.
fields.name: board0_mode

fields.description: Option selector byte of leaderboard record 0 in the 400-byte block at 0x0040.
fields.evidence: Byte 1 of the 16-byte record at save offset 0x40 inside the 400-byte block written by FUN_08002860 (param_1 bit 1, size 400) and verified by FUN_08002918 (bit 1); baseline value 0.
fields.name: board0_opt

fields.evidence: Bytes 2-5 of the 16-byte record at save offset 0x40 inside the 400-byte block written by FUN_08002860 (param_1 bit 1, size 400); baseline reads 'SEGA'.
fields.name: board0_name

fields.description: Score value of leaderboard record 0 (low 16 bits carry the score; high 16 bits are zero in baseline).
fields.evidence: Bytes 12-15 of the 16-byte record at save offset 0x40 inside the 400-byte block written by FUN_08002860 (param_1 bit 1, size 400) and verified by FUN_08002918 (bit 1); baseline value 39000.
fields.name: board0_score

fields.description: Status flags of ghost/time-attack slot 0 (bit 0 = active entry, bit 1 = dirty marker maintained by the save routines).
fields.evidence: Byte 0 of the 0x14-byte record at save offset 0x680 inside the 0xDC-byte block written by FUN_08002860 (param_1 bit 3, size 0xDC) and verified by FUN_08002918 (bit 3); FUN_080027e4 iterates 11 records with stride 0x14 clearing bit 1 (& 0xFD), FUN_08002860 sets bit 1 (| 2) on persist, and FUN_0801c66c tests bit 0 (& 1) before unpacking via the (param_2 * 0x14) record select; baseline value 0.
fields.name: ghost0_flags

fields.description: Time value of ghost/time-attack slot 0 (bytes 6-9 of the 0x14-byte record).
fields.evidence: Bytes 6-9 of the 0x14-byte record at save offset 0x680 inside the 0xDC-byte block written by FUN_08002860 (param_1 bit 3, size 0xDC) and verified by FUN_08002918 (bit 3); per-record select uses (param_2 & 0xFFFF) * 0x14 in FUN_08002860 / FUN_0801c66c; baseline value 2250.
fields.name: ghost0_time

fields.evidence: Bytes 10-13 of the 0x14-byte record at save offset 0x680 inside the 0xDC-byte block written by FUN_08002860 (param_1 bit 3, size 0xDC); baseline reads 'SEGA'.
fields.name: ghost0_name
